33152.a:
Uch joy:

| Joy | Nima | Buyruq |
|---|---|---|
| Working tree | Disk'dagi hozirgi fayllar | tahrirlash |
| Index (staging) | Keyingi commit snapshot'i | `git add`, `git restore --staged` |
| Repository | `.git/objects` — commit, tree, blob | `git commit` |

```sh
git status          # uchala joy farqi
git diff            # working tree vs index
git diff --staged   # index vs HEAD
```

**Nega index kerak:** bitta fayldagi o'zgarishlarning bir qismini commit qilish (`git add -p`) — commit'lar mantiqiy, kichik bo'ladi.

33153.a:
- `git clone URL` — butun repo + `origin` remote.
- `git fetch` — `origin/main` kabi remote-tracking branch'larni yangilaydi, **sizning branch'ingizni o'zgartirmaydi**. Xavfsiz.
- `git pull` = `fetch` + `merge` (`pull.rebase=true` bo'lsa rebase).
- `git push` — local commit'lar remote'ga. Remote oldinda bo'lsa rad etiladi (non-fast-forward).

Yaxshi odat:
```sh
git config --global pull.rebase true   # keraksiz merge commit yo'q
git fetch && git log HEAD..origin/main # avval nima kelishini ko'r
```

33154.a:
Branch = `.git/refs/heads/<nom>` faylidagi bitta commit hash. Yangi commit qilinganda pointer oldinga siljiydi.

```sh
git branch                 # ro'yxat
git switch -c feature/login  # yaratish + o'tish (eski: checkout -b)
git switch main
git branch -d feature/login  # merge qilingan bo'lsa o'chirish (-D majburiy)
git push -u origin feature/login  # remote'ga + upstream
```

`HEAD` — hozir qaysi branch'dasiz. **Detached HEAD** — branch emas, to'g'ridan commit'da turibsiz; u yerda qilingan commit branch'siz qoladi (`git switch -c new` bilan saqlang).

33155.a:
```
<<<<<<< HEAD
port: 8080
=======
port: 9090
>>>>>>> feature
```

Qadamlar:
1. `git status` — qaysi fayllarda konflikt.
2. Faylni tahrirlang, markerlarni olib tashlang, to'g'ri variantni qoldiring.
3. `git add file` keyin `git commit` (merge) yoki `git rebase --continue`.
4. Bekor qilish: `git merge --abort` / `git rebase --abort`.

Kamaytirish: kichik PR, tez-tez `main`dan yangilash, formatter (bir xil format).

33156.a:
```gitignore
.env
*.log
/bin/
node_modules/
!keep.log      # istisno
```

**Gotcha:** `.gitignore` faqat *untracked* fayllarga ta'sir qiladi.
```sh
git rm --cached .env   # index'dan olib tashlash, diskda qoladi
git commit -m "stop tracking .env"
```
Lekin `.env` tarixda qoladi — secret bo'lsa **rotate qiling** (tarixni tozalash yetarli emas).

Tekshirish: `git check-ignore -v path` — qaysi qoida ishladi.

33157.a:
```sh
git log --oneline --graph --all     # tarix daraxti
git log -p -- path/file             # fayl tarixi diff bilan
git log -S "funcName"               # shu matn qo'shilgan/o'chirilgan commit'lar (pickaxe)
git diff main...feature             # feature main'dan ajralgandan beri
git show <sha>                      # commit + diff
git blame -L 10,30 file.go          # qator muallifi
```

Debug'da: `blame` bilan commit topiladi, `show` bilan nega o'zgargani (commit message, PR) o'qiladi.

33158.a:
```
fix(auth): refresh token muddati tekshiruvini tuzatish

Token expiry'ni '<' bilan solishtirgan, chegaradagi token
qabul qilinardi. '<=' ga o'zgartirildi, test qo'shildi.

Refs: #142
```

- Sarlavha: nima qilindi; tana: **nega**.
- `feat:` / `fix:` / `chore:` / `refactor:` — changelog va semver avtomatik (semantic-release).
- "fix", "wip", "update" — yomon: 6 oydan keyin `git log` hech narsa aytmaydi.

33159.a:
```
merge:   A-B-C-----M (main)        rebase:  A-B-C-D'-E' (feature)
              \   /
               D-E
```

| | merge | rebase |
|---|---|---|
| Tarix | haqiqiy, tarmoqli | chiziqli, toza |
| Hash | o'zgarmaydi | yangi commit'lar |
| Konflikt | bir marta | har commit uchun |
| Xavf | yo'q | boshqalar ishlatgan branch'ni buzadi |

**Qoida:** o'zingizning local feature branch'ni `main` ustiga rebase — ok. Umumiy branch (`main`, boshqalar pull qilgan) — faqat merge. Rebase'dan keyin push: `git push --force-with-lease` (oddiy `--force` emas — boshqaning commit'ini o'chirmaydi).

33160.a:
| Buyruq | HEAD | Index | Working tree |
|---|---|---|---|
| `reset --soft X` | X | o'zgarmaydi | o'zgarmaydi |
| `reset --mixed X` (default) | X | X | o'zgarmaydi |
| `reset --hard X` | X | X | X — **o'zgarishlar yo'qoladi** |
| `revert X` | yangi commit | | |

```sh
git reset --soft HEAD~1   # oxirgi commit'ni "ochish", qayta commit qilish
git revert <sha>          # production'ga chiqqan bug commit'ni bekor qilish
```

Push qilingan tarixda **reset emas, revert**. `reset --hard` dan oldin `git stash` yoki `reflog`ni eslang.

33161.a:
```sh
git stash push -m "wip login"   # saqlash
git stash -u                    # untracked fayllar bilan
git stash list
git stash pop                   # qaytarish + o'chirish
git stash apply stash@{1}       # qaytarish, ro'yxatda qoladi
git stash drop stash@{0}
```

Holat: feature ustida ishlayapsiz, prod'da shoshilinch bug — `stash`, `switch main`, fix, qaytib `stash pop`.

**Gotcha:** stash uzoq yashasa unutiladi va konflikt beradi. Uzoq ish uchun WIP commit yoki `git worktree` yaxshiroq.

33162.a:
```sh
git switch release/1.4
git cherry-pick a1b2c3d        # bitta commit
git cherry-pick A^..B          # diapazon
git cherry-pick -x a1b2c3d     # message'ga "(cherry picked from ...)" — kuzatish oson
```

Ehtiyot:
- Commit boshqa commit'larga bog'liq bo'lsa konflikt yoki buzilgan kod.
- Ko'p cherry-pick = branch'lar ajralib ketgan belgisi (release strategiyani qayta ko'ring).

33163.a:
```sh
git reflog
# a1b2c3d HEAD@{0}: reset: moving to HEAD~3
# 9f8e7d6 HEAD@{1}: commit: add payment retry   <- kerakli
git branch rescue 9f8e7d6     # yoki: git reset --hard 9f8e7d6
```

- Commit qilingan narsa deyarli hech qachon yo'qolmaydi (gc'gacha).
- Commit **qilinmagan** o'zgarish `reset --hard` dan keyin reflog'da yo'q — qaytmaydi.
- Reflog local: boshqa clone'da yo'q.

33164.a:
| | GitFlow | Trunk-based |
|---|---|---|
| Branch'lar | main, develop, feature, release, hotfix | main + qisqa feature |
| Branch umri | kunlar–haftalar | soatlar–1-2 kun |
| Release | rejali | doimiy (CD) |
| Tugallanmagan kod | branch'da | main'da, feature flag ortida |

Trunk-based talabi: kuchli CI (har PR test), feature flag, kichik PR.
GitFlow hali ham o'rinli: bir nechta versiya qo'llab-quvvatlanadigan (on-prem, mobil) mahsulotlarda.

33165.a:
Tartib muhim:
1. **Rotate/revoke** — kalitni bekor qiling. Bot'lar GitHub'ni soniyalarda skan qiladi; tarixni tozalash yetarli emas (fork, clone, cache).
2. Audit: kalit bilan nima qilingan (cloud loglar).
3. Tarixdan olib tashlash:
```sh
git filter-repo --path .env --invert-paths
git push --force --all
```
4. Jamoa re-clone qiladi; GitHub support'dan cache tozalash.
5. Oldini olish: `gitleaks`/`trufflehog` pre-commit hook + CI, GitHub push protection, secret'lar Vault/secret manager'da.

33166.a:
```sh
git bisect start
git bisect bad              # hozirgi — buzuq
git bisect good v1.3.0      # bu versiya ishlagan
# Git o'rtadagi commit'ni checkout qiladi, test qiling:
git bisect good   # yoki bad
...
git bisect reset

# avtomatik: skript 0 = good, 1-127 = bad, 125 = skip
git bisect run go test ./pkg/payment -run TestRefund
```

Shart: har commit build bo'lishi kerak — kichik, atomik commit'lar bisect'ni ishlatadi.

33167.a:
```sh
git remote -v
git remote add upstream https://github.com/org/project.git
git fetch upstream
git switch main && git rebase upstream/main
git push origin main
```

Branch upstream'ini sozlash: `git push -u origin feat` — keyin oddiy `git push/pull`.
Ko'rish: `git branch -vv` — har branch qaysi remote'ni kuzatadi va qancha oldinda/orqada.

33168.a:
```sh
git tag -a v1.4.0 -m "Release 1.4.0"   # annotated
git tag v1.4.0-tmp                      # lightweight (faqat pointer)
git push origin v1.4.0                  # yoki --tags
git describe --tags                     # v1.4.0-3-g1a2b3c (tag'dan keyin 3 commit)
```

CI: `on: push: tags: ['v*']` — tag push'da release build, image `app:1.4.0` bilan teglanadi.
Semver: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. Tag'ni ko'chirish (force) yomon — boshqalarda eski qoladi.

33169.a:
```sh
# .git/hooks/pre-commit (yoki pre-commit framework)
#!/bin/sh
gofmt -l . | grep . && exit 1
gitleaks protect --staged || exit 1
```

- `.git/hooks` repo bilan **push qilinmaydi** — jamoa uchun `pre-commit` framework, husky yoki `core.hooksPath`.
- Hook — qulaylik (tez feedback), CI — **majburiy darvoza** (branch protection + required checks).
- Server-side hook'lar (pre-receive) — GitLab/GitHub Enterprise'da siyosat uchun.

33170.a:
| | Monorepo | Polyrepo |
|---|---|---|
| Cross-cutting o'zgarish | bitta PR | ko'p PR, versiya |
| CI | affected-only kerak | oddiy |
| Ownership | CODEOWNERS | repo darajasida |
| Git hajmi | katta | kichik |

Tezlashtirish:
```sh
git clone --filter=blob:none URL     # partial clone: blob kerakda yuklanadi
git clone --depth 1 URL              # CI uchun shallow
git sparse-checkout set services/api # faqat kerakli papka
git maintenance start                # fon optimizatsiya
```
CI: `paths:` filtri yoki Bazel/Nx/Turborepo bilan faqat o'zgargan qism.

33171.a:
```
commit 9f8e  -> tree a1b2 -> blob c3d4 (main.go)
   |                    -> tree e5f6 (pkg/) -> blob ...
   v parent
commit 7a6b
```

```sh
git cat-file -t HEAD          # commit
git cat-file -p HEAD          # tree, parent, author
git cat-file -p HEAD^{tree}
```

Oqibatlar:
- Bir xil fayl bir marta saqlanadi (dedup).
- Rebase/amend = **yangi** commit'lar (parent o'zgardi, hash o'zgardi).
- Branch/tag — shunchaki hash'ga ko'rsatkich; shuning uchun arzon.
- Git SHA-1'dan SHA-256'ga o'tish jarayonida (`--object-format=sha256`).

33172.a:
Minimal to'plam:
- Require PR + 1-2 approval, stale approval reset yangi push'da.
- **CODEOWNERS** — `/infra/` o'zgarsa platform jamoasi review majburiy.
- Required status checks: build, test, lint, security scan.
- Require branch up to date (yoki merge queue — katta jamoada).
- Force push / delete taqiqlangan, admin'larga ham.
- Squash yoki rebase merge — toza tarix.

Senior nuqta: qoidalar **kodda** (Terraform GitHub provider) — qo'lda bosilgan sozlama drift qiladi va audit qilinmaydi.

33173.a:
```sh
git lfs install
git lfs track "*.psd"
git add .gitattributes
```
LFS: repo'da kichik pointer fayl, mazmun LFS server'da; checkout'da kerakli versiya yuklanadi.

Qoida: build artefakt (binary, docker image, `.jar`) Git'ga emas — artifact registry (Nexus, Artifactory, GHCR, S3).
Allaqachon commit qilingan bo'lsa: `git lfs migrate import` yoki `filter-repo` (tarix qayta yoziladi — jamoa bilan kelishib).

33174.a:
ClickOps muammolari: kim nima o'zgartirgani noma'lum, staging ≠ prod, falokatdan keyin qayta qurish qo'lda va sekin.

IaC beradi:
- **Takrorlanish** — bir xil kod, bir xil muhit (dev/stage/prod).
- **Review** — PR orqali, `plan` diff bilan.
- **Tarix va rollback** — Git.
- **DR** — muhitni noldan ko'tarish.

Turlari: provisioning (Terraform/OpenTofu, Pulumi, CloudFormation) va configuration management (Ansible, Chef, Puppet).
Declarative (holatni yozasiz) vs imperative (qadamlarni yozasiz).

33176.a:
```sh
terraform init            # .terraform/, lock fayl, backend
terraform fmt && terraform validate
terraform plan -out tf.plan
terraform apply tf.plan   # aynan ko'rilgan plan bajariladi
terraform destroy         # ehtiyot!
```

Plan belgilar: `+` yaratish, `~` joyida o'zgartirish, `-/+` **o'chirib qayta yaratish** (replace — downtime/ma'lumot yo'qolishi mumkin), `-` o'chirish.

Qoida: prod'da `plan` saqlanadi va review qilinadi, keyin aynan o'sha fayl `apply` qilinadi.

33177.a:
State'siz Terraform `aws_instance.web` qaysi EC2 ekanini bilmaydi.

State'da: resource ID'lari, atributlar, dependency'lar, **ko'pincha parollar ochiq matnda** (masalan RDS password).

Qoidalar:
- Git'ga emas — remote backend (S3 + lock, GCS, Terraform Cloud).
- Shifrlangan, kirish cheklangan.
- Qo'lda tahrirlamang — `terraform state mv/rm`, `import` buyruqlari bor.

```sh
terraform state list
terraform state show aws_instance.web
```

33178.a:
```hcl
terraform {
  backend "s3" {
    bucket       = "acme-tfstate"
    key          = "prod/network/terraform.tfstate"
    region       = "eu-central-1"
    encrypt      = true
    use_lockfile = true      # S3 native lock (1.10+); eski: dynamodb_table
  }
}
```

- Lock ushlangan bo'lsa ikkinchi `apply` kutadi/xato beradi.
- Osilib qolgan lock: `terraform force-unlock ID` — faqat hech kim ishlamayotganiga ishonch bo'lsa.
- Bucket: versioning yoqilgan (state'ni tiklash), public access block, KMS.
- Eng yaxshisi: apply faqat CI'dan (bitta yo'l), odamlar faqat plan ko'radi.

33179.a:
```sh
terraform plan -refresh-only    # faqat real holatni state'ga solishtirish
terraform plan -detailed-exitcode  # 0 = o'zgarish yo'q, 2 = drift/o'zgarish
```

Jarayon:
1. Scheduled CI job har kuni `plan -detailed-exitcode` — exit 2 bo'lsa alert.
2. Qaror: o'zgarish to'g'rimi? Ha — kodga qo'shing. Yo'q — `apply` bilan qaytaring.
3. Oldini olish: prod konsolda write huquqi yo'q (read-only IAM), o'zgarish faqat pipeline orqali.

`lifecycle { ignore_changes = [tags["LastScanned"]] }` — tashqi tizim ataylab o'zgartiradigan maydonlar uchun.

33180.a:
```hcl
module "vpc" {
  source  = "terraform-aws-modules/vpc/aws"
  version = "5.8.1"
  name = "prod"
  cidr = "10.0.0.0/16"
  azs             = ["eu-central-1a", "eu-central-1b"]
  private_subnets = ["10.0.1.0/24", "10.0.2.0/24"]
}

resource "aws_eks_cluster" "this" {
  vpc_config { subnet_ids = module.vpc.private_subnets }
}
```

Qoidalar:
- Versiyani **pin** qiling (git tag yoki registry version) — `main`ga bog'lanish kutilmagan o'zgarish beradi.
- Variable'larga `type`, `description`, `validation`.
- Juda umumiy "hamma narsa" modul — anti-pattern; kichik, kompozitsiyalanadigan modullar.

33181.a:
```hcl
# xavfli: "b" o'chirilsa "c" index 2 -> 1, replace bo'ladi
resource "aws_iam_user" "u" {
  count = length(var.users)
  name  = var.users[count.index]
}

# barqaror: manzil aws_iam_user.u["c"]
resource "aws_iam_user" "u" {
  for_each = toset(var.users)
  name     = each.key
}
```
`count` hali ham ok: `count = var.enabled ? 1 : 0` (shartli resurs).
Migratsiya: `moved` blok yoki `terraform state mv 'x[1]' 'x["c"]'`.

33182.a:
```hcl
# Terraform 1.5+: deklarativ import
import {
  to = aws_s3_bucket.logs
  id = "acme-logs"
}
# terraform plan -generate-config-out=gen.tf  # kod skeletini yaratadi

# refactor: nom o'zgardi, resurs qayta yaratilmasin
moved {
  from = aws_instance.web
  to   = module.web.aws_instance.this
}
```
`moved`siz rename = plan'da `-` va `+` = prod'da DB o'chishi mumkin. Har refactor'dan keyin plan "0 to destroy" ekanini tekshiring.

33183.a:
```hcl
data "aws_secretsmanager_secret_version" "db" { secret_id = "prod/db" }

resource "aws_db_instance" "main" {
  username = "app"
  manage_master_user_password = true   # parolni AWS o'zi yaratadi va Secrets Manager'da saqlaydi
}

variable "api_key" { type = string  sensitive = true }  # TF_VAR_api_key env'dan
```

- `sensitive` = plan/output'da yashirin, **state'da emas**.
- State: shifrlangan backend, minimal kirish.
- Iloji bo'lsa secret'ni Terraform orqali umuman o'tkazmang (managed password, IAM role, OIDC).

33184.a:
```
modules/
  vpc/  eks/  rds/
envs/
  dev/   main.tf  backend.tf (key=dev/...)   terraform.tfvars
  prod/  main.tf  backend.tf (key=prod/...)  terraform.tfvars
```

Afzalligi: har muhit alohida state (blast radius kichik), alohida IAM/account, prod'ga modulning yangi versiyasini kechroq chiqarish mumkin.

Workspace (`terraform workspace select prod`) — vaqtinchalik/preview muhitlar uchun yaxshi. Prod uchun xavfli: noto'g'ri workspace'da `apply`.
Takrorlanishni kamaytirish: Terragrunt yoki Terraform Stacks.

33185.a:
Muammo: bitta ulkan state — plan 10 daqiqa, hamma bir-birini bloklaydi, bitta xato hammasini buzadi.

Tuzilma:
```
platform/network   (egasi: platform)   -> outputs: vpc_id, subnets
platform/eks
data/rds           (egasi: data team)
apps/payments      (egasi: payments)   -> remote_state yoki SSM'dan o'qiydi
```
- Layer'lar orasida bog'lanish: `terraform_remote_state` yoki SSM Parameter Store (kamroq coupling).
- CI: PR -> `plan` izoh -> review (CODEOWNERS) -> merge -> `apply`. Cloud'ga kirish OIDC (static key yo'q).
- Gate'lar: `tflint`, `checkov`/`trivy config`, OPA (masalan "S3 public bo'lmasin"), cost (`infracost`).
- Provider va modul versiyalari pin, `.terraform.lock.hcl` commit qilinadi.

33187.a:
| | Terraform/OpenTofu | Pulumi | CloudFormation/CDK |
|---|---|---|---|
| Til | HCL | Go/TS/Python | YAML/JSON, CDK = TS/Python |
| Cloud | multi | multi | AWS |
| State | o'zingiz (backend) | Pulumi Cloud/self | AWS boshqaradi |
| Kuchli | ekotizim, modul'lar | abstraksiya, test | AWS bilan chuqur integratsiya |
| Zaif | HCL cheklovlari | "aqlli" kod murakkablashadi | sekin, faqat AWS |

Odatiy tanlov: Terraform/OpenTofu. Litsenziya: Terraform 1.6+ BSL — o'zingiz ishlatishga to'sqinlik yo'q, raqobatchi mahsulot qurishga bor.

33188.a:
| | Terraform | Ansible |
|---|---|---|
| Vazifa | resurs yaratish (VM, VPC, DB) | server ichini sozlash |
| Model | declarative + state | task'lar ketma-ketligi (idempotent modullar) |
| State | bor | yo'q (har safar real holatni tekshiradi) |
| Ulanish | cloud API | SSH / WinRM |

Konteyner davrida Ansible roli kichraydi (image ichida sozlanadi), lekin VM, bare-metal, tarmoq qurilmalari, OS hardening uchun hali keng.

33189.a:
```ini
# inventory.ini
[web]
web1 ansible_host=10.0.1.10
web2 ansible_host=10.0.1.11
[db]
db1 ansible_host=10.0.2.10
```

```yaml
# site.yml
- hosts: web
  become: true
  tasks:
    - name: nginx o'rnatish
      ansible.builtin.apt: { name: nginx, state: present, update_cache: true }
    - name: nginx ishlasin
      ansible.builtin.service: { name: nginx, state: started, enabled: true }
```
```sh
ansible-playbook -i inventory.ini site.yml
ansible web -i inventory.ini -m ping     # ad-hoc
```

33190.a:
```yaml
# idempotent: paket bor bo'lsa "ok"
- ansible.builtin.apt: { name: nginx, state: present }

# idempotent emas: har safar ishlaydi
- ansible.builtin.shell: echo "x" >> /etc/app.conf

# to'g'rilangan
- ansible.builtin.lineinfile: { path: /etc/app.conf, line: "x" }

# command'ni idempotent qilish
- ansible.builtin.command: /opt/app/init.sh
  args: { creates: /opt/app/.initialized }
```
Tekshiruv: ikkinchi ishga tushirishda `changed=0` bo'lishi kerak. `--check --diff` — dry run.

33191.a:
```yaml
tasks:
  - name: nginx config
    ansible.builtin.template: { src: nginx.conf.j2, dest: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf }
    notify: reload nginx

handlers:
  - name: reload nginx
    ansible.builtin.service: { name: nginx, state: reloaded }
```
- Bir nechta task notify qilsa ham handler **bir marta**.
- Play o'rtasida kerak bo'lsa: `meta: flush_handlers`.
- Config'ni reload'dan oldin tekshirish: template'da `validate: nginx -t -c %s`.

33192.a:
```
inventory/
  hosts.ini
  group_vars/
    all.yml        # hamma
    web.yml        # web guruhi
  host_vars/
    web1.yml
roles/nginx/defaults/main.yml   # o'zgartirilishi mumkin bo'lgan default
```
Precedence (soddalashtirilgan, pastdan yuqoriga): role defaults < inventory vars < group_vars/all < group_vars/<grp> < host_vars < play vars < role vars < `-e`.

Amaliyot: role `defaults/`da hamma sozlanuvchi qiymat, muhit farqi `group_vars`da, `-e` faqat bir martalik override uchun.
Debug: `ansible-inventory --host web1`, `debug: var=hostvars[inventory_hostname]`.

33193.a:
```jinja
# templates/upstream.conf.j2
upstream app {
{% for h in groups['app'] %}
  server {{ hostvars[h].ansible_host }}:{{ app_port | default(8080) }};
{% endfor %}
}
```
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.template:
    src: upstream.conf.j2
    dest: /etc/nginx/conf.d/upstream.conf
    owner: root
    mode: "0644"
    validate: nginx -t -c %s
  notify: reload nginx
```
`copy` — statik fayl, `template` — o'zgaruvchili. Facts: `ansible_facts['distribution']`, `ansible_memtotal_mb`.

33194.a:

```
[app /metrics] <---scrape--- [Prometheus TSDB] ---> [Grafana]
```

33197.a:
| Tur | Misol | Qanday so'raladi |
|---|---|---|
| Counter | `http_requests_total` | `rate(x[5m])` — xom qiymat ma'nosiz |
| Gauge | `node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes` | to'g'ridan, `avg_over_time` |
| Histogram | `http_request_duration_seconds_bucket` | `histogram_quantile(0.99, ...)` |
| Summary | `go_gc_duration_seconds` | tayyor quantile, instance'lar bo'yicha yig'ib bo'lmaydi |

Latency uchun **histogram** tanlang — bir nechta pod p99'ini to'g'ri hisoblash mumkin.
Counter restart'da 0 ga tushadi — `rate()` buni avtomatik to'g'rilaydi.

33198.a:
```promql
# RPS servis bo'yicha
sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total[5m]))

# xatolar ulushi
sum(rate(http_requests_total{code=~"5.."}[5m]))
  / sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m]))

# p99 latency
histogram_quantile(0.99,
  sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])))

# disk 4 soatda to'ladimi
predict_linear(node_filesystem_avail_bytes[6h], 4*3600) < 0

# ishlamayotgan target'lar
up == 0
```
`rate` vs `irate`: irate oxirgi 2 nuqta — keskin, dashboard uchun; alert uchun `rate`.

33199.a:
Series soni = label qiymatlari ko'paytmasi: 5 method × 20 route × 6 status × 50 pod = 30 000. `user_id` (1M) qo'shilsa = 30 mlrd.

Qoidalar:
- Label = **chegaralangan** qiymat: method, route shabloni (`/users/:id`, `/users/42` emas), status class.
- Yuqori kardinallikli ma'lumot — log/trace'ga (exemplar orqali bog'lash).
- Tekshirish:
```promql
topk(10, count by (__name__) ({__name__=~".+"}))
```
`promtool tsdb analyze`, Grafana Cardinality dashboard.
- Himoya: `sample_limit`, `metric_relabel_configs` bilan label'ni drop qilish.

33200.a:
```yaml
groups:
- name: api
  rules:
  - alert: HighErrorRate
    expr: |
      sum(rate(http_requests_total{code=~"5.."}[5m]))
        / sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m])) > 0.05
    for: 10m
    labels: { severity: page, team: payments }
    annotations:
      summary: "5xx > 5% (10 daqiqa)"
      runbook_url: https://wiki/runbooks/high-error-rate
```
Alertmanager: `group_by: [alertname, cluster]` — 100 pod bitta xabar; `inhibit_rules` — cluster down bo'lsa pod alertlari bostiriladi.
Yaxshi alert: **simptom** (foydalanuvchi his qiladi) ustida, runbook bilan, actionable. CPU 80% — odatda page emas.

33201.a:
Tuzilma:
1. **Overview qatori:** RPS, error %, p99 latency, SLO burn rate.
2. **Dependency'lar:** DB, cache, tashqi API latency/xato.
3. **Resurslar (USE):** CPU, memory, saturation (throttling, navbat), restart'lar.

Amaliyot:
- Template variable: `$env`, `$service` — bitta dashboard hamma servisga.
- Birliklar (s, bytes, %), threshold ranglari.
- Annotation: deploy vaqtlari — "latency deploy'dan keyin oshdi" darhol ko'rinadi.
- Provisioning (Git'da JSON, Grafana as code) — qo'lda tahrir yo'qolmaydi.
- 40 panel — hech kim o'qimaydi. Har dashboard bitta savolga javob bersin.

33202.a:
```promql
# CPU band %
100 - avg by (instance)(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[5m])) * 100

# mavjud xotira %
node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes * 100

# disk bo'sh %
node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"}
  / node_filesystem_size_bytes * 100

# disk band (saturation)
rate(node_disk_io_time_seconds_total[5m])
```
Gotcha: `MemFree` emas `MemAvailable` — Linux page cache'ni "band" ko'rsatadi, lekin u bo'shatiladi.
Inode tugashi ham "No space left on device" beradi: `node_filesystem_files_free`.

33203.a:
```
cluster A: Prometheus x2 (HA) --remote_write-->
cluster B: Prometheus x2      --remote_write--> Mimir/Thanos (S3) <- Grafana (global query)
```
- **HA:** ikkita bir xil Prometheus, Alertmanager cluster dedupe qiladi.
- **Recording rules** — og'ir so'rovlarni oldindan hisoblash (`job:http_requests:rate5m`), dashboard tez.
- **Downsampling** — eski ma'lumot 5m/1h rezolyutsiyada (Thanos compactor).
- Federation — eski usul, faqat agregatlar uchun.

Avval kardinallikni nazorat qiling: ko'pincha "scale muammosi" = keraksiz label'lar.

33204.a:
- **Region:** ma'lumot qayerda yotishi (qonun, latency), narx regionga qarab farq qiladi. Ko'p xizmatlar region darajasida.
- **AZ:** alohida elektr, sovutish, tarmoq. Bitta AZ yiqilishi odatiy hodisa deb loyihalanadi.
- **Edge:** CDN cache, DNS.

Qoida: production = multi-AZ (ALB + 2+ AZ'da instance/pod, RDS Multi-AZ). Multi-region — qimmat va murakkab, faqat haqiqiy RTO/RPO talab qilsa.
Gotcha: AZ'lar orasidagi trafik pullik.

33205.a:
| Oila | Qachon |
|---|---|
| t3/t4g | kichik, notekis yuk (CPU credit) |
| m7i/m7g | umumiy servislar |
| c7i/c7g | CPU-bound (API, encoding) |
| r7i/r7g | xotira (cache, DB) |

Narx modellari: On-Demand, Savings Plans/Reserved (1-3 yil, ~40-70% arzon), Spot (90% gacha arzon, 2 daqiqa ogohlantirish bilan olib qo'yiladi — stateless/batch uchun).
Gotcha: `t` instance CPU credit tugasa sekinlashadi — doimiy yuk uchun `m`.
AMI — image, user data — birinchi boot skripti, EBS — disk.

33206.a:
```sh
aws s3 cp backup.tar.gz s3://acme-backups/2026/10/
aws s3 sync ./site s3://acme-site --delete
aws s3 presign s3://acme-files/video.mp4 --expires-in 3600
```
- **Block Public Access** default yoqiq — shunday qolsin. Public kontent — CloudFront orqali.
- Versioning + lifecycle (eski versiyalarni Glacier'ga, keyin o'chirish).
- Shifrlash: SSE-S3 default, KMS — audit/kalit nazorati uchun.
- Katta fayl upload: client to'g'ridan S3'ga **presigned URL** bilan (server orqali emas).
- Strong read-after-write consistency (2020'dan).

33207.a:
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Action": ["s3:GetObject"],
    "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::acme-reports/*"
  }]

```
Qoidalar:
- Ilovaga **role** (EC2 instance profile, EKS IRSA/Pod Identity, Lambda role) — access key emas.
- Odamlar: SSO (IAM Identity Center), MFA; root account faqat favqulodda, MFA bilan.
- Least privilege: `*` dan qoching, IAM Access Analyzer.
- Explicit `Deny` har doim `Allow`dan ustun.

33208.a:
```
              Internet
                 |
         [Internet Gateway]
                 |
  VPC 10.0.0.0/16
  +-- public 10.0.1.0/24  : ALB, NAT GW, bastion
  |        route 0.0.0.0/0 -> IGW
  +-- private 10.0.11.0/24: app (EC2/EKS)
  |        route 0.0.0.0/0 -> NAT GW
  +-- private 10.0.21.0/24: RDS (internetga yo'l yo'q)
```
- Har AZ'da public + private subnet.
- NAT GW pullik (soat + GB) — S3/DynamoDB uchun **VPC endpoint** (gateway, bepul) xarajatni kamaytiradi.
- CIDR'ni boshidan katta va boshqa VPC/ofis bilan kesishmaydigan tanlang (peering uchun).

33209.a:
| | Security Group | NACL |
|---|---|---|
| Daraja | ENI (instance) | subnet |
| State | stateful | stateless (ephemeral port'larni ham ochish kerak) |
| Qoidalar | faqat allow | allow + deny, raqam tartibida |
| Manba | IP yoki **boshqa SG** | faqat CIDR |

Amaliyot: asosiy himoya SG — "DB SG faqat app SG'dan 5432 ga". IP emas, SG reference — autoscaling'da ham ishlaydi.
NACL — qo'pol blok (masalan, ma'lum CIDR'ni deny). 0.0.0.0/0 dan 22-port — xato; SSM Session Manager ishlating.

33210.a:
| | ALB | NLB |
|---|---|---|
| Qatlam | L7 | L4 |
| Routing | path, host, header | port |
| TLS | termination, SNI | passthrough yoki termination |
| IP | o'zgaruvchan (DNS) | statik / Elastic IP |
| WAF | bor | yo'q |

Health check: ALB `/healthz` HTTP 200 — yiqilgan target trafik olmaydi.
Deregistration delay (connection draining) — deploy paytida mavjud so'rovlar tugaydi.
K8s'da: AWS Load Balancer Controller — Ingress -> ALB, Service type LoadBalancer -> NLB.

33211.a:
- **Multi-AZ** = HA (failover), o'qish uchun ishlatilmaydi (Multi-AZ cluster bundan mustasno).
- **Read replica** = scale, replication lag bor, failover avtomatik emas.
- PITR: istalgan soniyaga **yangi** instance sifatida tiklanadi — endpoint o'zgaradi.
- Private subnet, SG faqat app'dan, `storage_encrypted`, `deletion_protection`.
- Ulanishlar ko'p (Lambda, ko'p pod) bo'lsa — RDS Proxy yoki PgBouncer.
- Aurora: storage 3 AZ'da 6 nusxa, tezroq failover, qimmatroq.

Backup'ni tiklashni **sinab ko'ring** — tiklanmagan backup = backup emas.

33212.a:
```sh
aws logs tail /ecs/api --follow --since 10m
aws cloudwatch describe-alarms --state-value ALARM
```
- Default EC2 metrikalarida **memory va disk yo'q** — agent o'rnating.
- Logs Insights — so'rov tili:
```
fields @timestamp, @message
| filter level = "error"
| stats count() by bin(5m)
```
- Log retention default "Never expire" — xarajat o'sadi, retention qo'ying.
- Muhim alarm'lar: ALB 5xx, target unhealthy, RDS CPU/storage/connections, billing.

33213.a:
Tez yutuqlar:
- **AWS Budgets** alert (oylik limit 80%/100%).
- Har resursda tag: `team`, `env`, `service` — Cost Explorer'da kim qancha sarflagani.
- Dev muhitni kechasi o'chirish (scheduler).
- Yashirin xarajatlar: NAT Gateway GB'lari, AZ'lar aro trafik, internetga egress, CloudWatch Logs, gp2 -> gp3 (arzonroq).
- Yetim resurslar: unattached EBS, eski AMI/snapshot, Elastic IP.
- Graviton (ARM) instance — ~20% arzon.
- Barqaror yuk — Savings Plans; batch — Spot.

33215.a:
```sh
sudo nginx -t && sudo systemctl reload nginx
sudo nginx -T | less        # to'liq yig'ilgan config (include'lar bilan)
```
- Reload'da config xato bo'lsa master eski config'da qoladi — lekin har doim avval `-t`.
- Fayllar: `/etc/nginx/nginx.conf`, `conf.d/*.conf` yoki `sites-available` + symlink `sites-enabled` (Debian).
- Loglar: `/var/log/nginx/access.log`, `error.log` — 502/504 sababi error.log'da.

33216.a:
```nginx
location = /healthz      { return 200 "ok"; }      # 1. aniq moslik
location ^~ /static/     { root /var/www; }         # 2. prefix, regex tekshirilmaydi
location ~* \.(png|jpg)$ { expires 30d; }           # 3. regex, birinchi mos kelgan
location /api/           { proxy_pass http://api; } # 4. eng uzun prefix
location /               { proxy_pass http://web; }
```
Gotcha: `default_server` bo'lmasa, noma'lum Host bilan kelgan so'rov **birinchi** server blokiga tushadi — boshqa saytingiz ochilib qolishi mumkin. Catch-all: `server { listen 80 default_server; return 444; }`.

33217.a:
```sh
sudo apt install certbot python3-certbot-nginx
sudo certbot --nginx -d example.com -d www.example.com
sudo certbot renew --dry-run
systemctl list-timers | grep certbot
```
- HTTP-01: 80-port ochiq bo'lishi kerak. Wildcard (`*.example.com`) — faqat DNS-01.
- 90 kun — avtomatlashtirishga majburlaydi. Muddat tugashini monitoring qiling (blackbox_exporter `probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry`).
- Rate limit bor — test uchun `--staging`.

33220.a:
Debug tartibi:
```sh
tail -f /var/log/nginx/error.log
# connect() failed (111: Connection refused)  -> 502: backend ishlamayapti / port
# upstream timed out (110) while reading      -> 504: backend sekin
# no live upstreams                           -> hamma server max_fails bilan chiqarilgan
systemctl status app; ss -tlnp | grep 8080
curl -v http://127.0.0.1:8080/healthz      # Nginx'siz to'g'ridan
```
- SELinux: `connect() ... (13: Permission denied)` -> `setsebool -P httpd_can_network_connect 1`.
- 504'ni timeout'ni oshirib "tuzatish" — odatda simptomni yashirish; sekin endpoint'ni toping.
- Access log'ga `$upstream_response_time` qo'shing.
